name: AISkills402
description: AISkills402 sells tested AI agent skill files (SKILL.md, Agent Skills format). An agent buys the FILE of a skill once, over the x402 protocol, in USDC on Base mainnet, for cents. No account and no API key. The agent keeps the file: re-downloads and new versions of a skill it owns are free. A few skills are also sold as separate pay-per-call APIs. Start at https://aiskills402.com/llms.txt and https://api.aiskills402.com/openapi.json.
